about.value: Experience the impossible at Museum of Illusions Atlanta! Our exhibits promise mind-bending fun and a deeper understanding of the science behind optical illusions in an interactive experience suitable for adults and children alike. With over 60 interactive exhibits, you'll explore a fascinating world of optical illusions and the science behind them.
